annotations.title: Get a venue, trail, event, ski resort or airport

description: Read the Meridian Dispatch field record for one place: a sight, museum, beach or park, a trail or scenic drive, an event, a ski resort, or an airport. Returns the best time to go, how long it takes, effort, season, access, how to get there and what goes wrong, plus the best months, practical answers, a photo, the town guide link, reviews by travellers who went when there are any (traveller_reviews) and a citation; an event adds its dates and schedule, a trail its route facts, an airport (airport) how to get from the terminal to each town by bus, taxi or ride-hailing app with the road distance, the arrival steps, security rules, food before and after security, airlines and the airports they fly to, what to do on a layover by time available, and what is not yet confirmed. Use it once you know the place. For a whole country or town use get_destination; for a dispatch use get_dispatch; to find a place you cannot name exactly use search_guides; for what else is close use list_nearby. Give url, name or (for an airport) iata, at least one. A place mentioned on a town guide with no page of its own returns its short write-up and that guide. A URL of a town, country or dispatch page returns that guide instead. Read-only. No match returns an error message.

country.description: The place's country, by English name, to narrow a name shared by several places.

iata.description: An airport's three-letter IATA code, e.g. "MLA" for Malta International Airport. Returns that airport's page: getting into town, airlines, security, food and layovers.

name.description: The place's name, e.g. "Kotor Old Town" or "Grunas Waterfall". Exact names match first, then names that contain it. A bare three-letter airport code ("MLA") is read as iata.

town.description: The town the place is in or visited from, e.g. "Kotor", to narrow a name shared by several places.

url.description: The place's meridiandispatch.com page URL, from a search_guides or get_destination result. Takes priority over name.

name: get_place

airport.description: For an airport: iata, getting_out (one entry per destination: to, guide, distance, options [{mode, how}]), arrival_steps, security, food (by where: before security, after security, outside), airlines (by region: routes [{to, carriers}], dated by airlines_as_of), layover (by time available), bus_stops, walks_from_terminal, at_a_glance, not_yet_confirmed. Fares are never given: how to pay is.

at_a_glance.description: Best time, time needed, effort, season, access.

event.description: For an event: dates, best day, when to book, where to stay, schedule.

official_tickets.description: The place's own online ticket shop, when it has one. Never a reseller.

photo.description: Lead photograph: url, alt text and credit.

practical.description: Questions travellers ask about the place, each {q, a}, as the page answers them. Where the page can open at its FAQ, each also has a url: cite that link when the answer came from it.

source.description: How to credit this answer: show cite_as, or link url.

cite_as.description: A ready-made citation line: title, publisher, date and URL.

corrections.description: How to report an error on this page (suggest_edit).

url.description: Link for the reader (carries referral tags).

traveller_reviews.description: Reviews by travellers who went, when there are any: verdict (Worth it to Skip it), rating out of 5, count, and up to five reviews, each {verdict, text, by, visited, countries_visited, published}. Opinions, not the guide.

title: Get a venue, trail, event, ski resort or airport
